# A configuration whose Include is at the bottom, which is where a drop-in
# loses: sshd takes the first value it is given, so PasswordAuthentication
# below wins over anything /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d says.

Port 22
PermitRootLogin no
PasswordAuthentication yes
PubkeyAuthentication yes

Include /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/*.conf
